summary: Unexpected duplicate external webhook invocations when SDK long-poll retry + nonce rotation enabled
description: Issue summary: Customer reports duplicate POST callbacks to their external webhook when using our streaming long-poll SDK with automatic retry enabled and nonce rotation turned on. Impact: Multiple duplicate downstream side-effects (order inserts) observed; customer classified as enterprise and has live traffic. Environment: prod, us-east primary region, client using TS SDK 1.8.3 and Python SDK 0.9.1 via a serverless orchestrator. Observed behavior: When the client loses the long-poll connection and the SDK transparently retries, external webhook endpoints receive 2-3 POSTs with the same logical tool invocation. Expected behavior: Webhook should receive a single POST for a completed tool invocation even across reconnect/retry cycles when idempotency semantics are used.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer uses TS streaming client with 'longPoll' mode and enables per-session nonce rotation (default enabled in 1.8.x).
2) Initiate a tool/function call that triggers an outbound webhook (external callback) from Redwood.
3) Kill the long-poll connection mid-stream (simulated network flake) so the SDK automatically reconnects.
4) Observe webhook receiver logs for duplicate POSTs within ~2s window.
Notes: Repro is intermittent (~1/50 reconnects) but consistent when simulated with rapid connect/disconnect loops.

comments: 2026-03-10 - Customer (Peregrine): 'We've started seeing duplicate order inserts tied to webhook callbacks whenever our app reconnects after a temp network drop. This started after upgrading to SDK 1.8.3.'

2026-03-10 - Support (Ava Thompson): 'Thanks — we've triaged and assigned to Eng. Can you share a short packet capture or edge trace id? Also confirm whether you have per-action idempotency tokens or rely on session scope.'
2026-03-10 - Customer: 'We rely on session-scoped nonce rotation (default). Attached edge trace id rwd-9f3b and webhook logs.'

2026-03-11 - Engineer (Marcus Li): 'Initial hypothesis: SDK long-poll retry path rotates nonce prior to completing the dedupe header regeneration, causing the server to treat the reconnect as a fresh session while re-emitting inflight tool callbacks. Reproduced locally with a deterministic reconnect harness.'

2026-03-11 - Engineer (Marcus Li): 'Opened PRs to SDK and webhook-proxy to ensure idempotency header is preserved across retry handshake. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2489, https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4976'

2026-03-12 - Support (Ava Thompson): 'Customer applied temporary workaround: disable automatic nonce rotation (SDK config) and enable per-action idempotency token on their orchestration layer — duplicates stopped in their canary.'
investigation_notes:
- Reproduced using a synthetic reconnect harness against staging and prod-like environments.
- Root cause: race between long-poll reconnect flow and nonce rotation timer in TS SDK v1.8.x. On reconnect the SDK rotated the session nonce before reattaching inflight tool callback state; webhook-proxy observed the reconnect as session change and requeued the outbound callback rather than deduping by the preserved in-flight token.
- The webhook-proxy relied on client-supplied idempotency metadata present in the session context; when nonce changed, session-scoped keys were recalculated and didn't match previously stored inflight dedupe entries.
- Python SDK showed similar behavior when the orchestrator performed mid-call token rotation; frequency lower due to different token timer defaults.
- No evidence of user error in customer code; root cause in SDK retry lifecycle.
resolution:
- Deployed hotfix in SDK: delay nonce rotation until inflight callbacks are reconciled on reconnect (merged: sdk PR #2489).
- Webhook-proxy update to match dedupe lookups by stable invocation identifier if present, fallback to session keys (merged: runtime PR #4976).
- Rollout plan: staged rollout to edge fleet (10% -> 50% -> 100%) over 48 hours; monitoring alert set for duplicate webhook rate >0.1% per minute.
- Customer workaround: set 'nonceRotation: false' in SDK config OR attach explicit per-action idempotency_token to each tool call until fix is rolled out.
- Post-rollback verification: customer confirmed no duplicates in their canary after workaround.
- Follow-up: Add a unit/integration test that simulates rapid reconnect+nonce rotation and assert single outbound callback per invocation (task INT-22410).
